card.name: Partway through drug names
card.fires_on: Mid-way or final pieces of brand and generic drug names, especially the last piece before a following word like 'prescribing information' or 'can cause'. Also a few stray spots such as a year digit or 'antidepress' before 'ant'.

modes.label: Generic name ending
modes.description: Final piece of a generic drug name such as nivolumab or lazertinib in a 'refer to the ... prescribing information' phrase.

modes.label: Brand name piece
modes.description: Last or middle piece of an uppercase brand name in a safety statement or adverse-event comparison.

modes.label: Stray spots
modes.description: Occasional non-drug-name spots, such as a year digit or the word 'this' before 'combination regimen'.
